Name: Cuter Sebastian Sprite with Hoodie
Author: Miezefratze
Description:
To get this Sebastian Sprite to work:

 Locate your \Stardew Valley\ Folder. Which is probably either:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\ for 64bit Windows Users
C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\ for 32bit Windows Users

or,
C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\

Go into the Content Folder, go into the Characters Folder and copy your Sebastian.xnb anywhere to back it up, after that, just replace him, thats it.

If you have any suggestions for the Sprite or other Stuff (since that is my first try) please feel free to contact me.
